CustomField.description: Semicolon-separated Case Record Type Developer Names to exclude. Cases with a matching Record Type will be skipped by this rule, even if all other criteria match. Leave blank to exclude no record types.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Enter Record Type Developer Names separated by semicolons (;) to exclude from this rule. Use the Developer Name (API name), not the display label. Example: Internal_Case;Test_Case. To find Developer Names: Setup > Object Manager > Case > Record Types. Leave blank to exclude no record types.
CustomField.label: Exclude Record Type Developer Names
